notes: Summary: Mid-market product search SaaS (B2B) exploring hosted API with plan to move to Dedicated for predictable SLAs. Primary interest in Redwood reranking endpoints to run lightweight re-ranker after dense retrieval. Team: Head of Search (product) Priya Shah, Eng lead (backend) Tomas Erickson, ML lead (relevance) Kevin Liu. POC scope: 2-week pilot using existing evaluation sets (approx 10k queries + human judgments) to compare current BM25+embed+ML re-ranker vs Redwood rerank endpoint offline scoring. Requirements: latency p95 < 120ms for rerank calls at 200 qps, cost sensitivity (target < $0.03/query processed), ability to run offline batch scoring (they will upload eval sets), model explainability for quality regressions, and fallback to cheaper model variant when Dedicated capacity constrained. Security: must pass SOC2 checklist, SSO/SAML + audit logging, ability to restrict model telemetry and retention 30 days. Demo feedback: liked streaming outputs, request to add top-k scoring and confidence scores. Pricing conversation: prefers per-route pricing + committed burst capacity; asked for a 12-mo committed Dedicated quote. Sales timeline: want internal procurement by end-Apr. Quotes: asked for two options: hosted pilot then committed Dedicated vs direct Dedicated with migration credit. POC notes: "We need to see actual rerank scores on our eval set before committing — quality is king", - Priya. Action items: SE to run sample rerank on 1k query subset by 2026-03-12; security questionnaire needs Item 4 on data residency clarified (US-only); finance to get rough ARR number for procurement by 2026-03-22.
